response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), city_shares AS (SELECT city, attendance_count, attendance_count * 1.0 / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), compared AS (SELECT attendance_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM city_shares) SELECT AVG(attendance_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_share_above_overall FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
